scope.antifaSampling: Purposive, not representative: cases were selected to test different attribution problems, including proven cells, self-identified individuals, mixed crowds, unresolved prosecutions, foreign organizations, and durable false rumors.
scope.prevalenceWarning: Counts in the ANTIFA ledger must not be interpreted as prevalence estimates or as a random sample of political violence.
